At the beginning of your shift, you prepare for your assigned route. Once you are ready, you get into the delivery van and head towards your first customer. You therefore need to be comfortable with an active working day. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Bleiswijk You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Previous delivery experience is not required. Would you like to combine driving with an active job in Bleiswijk? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. jobs.description: - Werken bij Vanderlande - Evenementen  - URL copied  Werkgebied  Locatie  Veghel, Netherlands.  Contract type  Full time  - URL copied Assignment type : Graduation Start date : February 2026 Assignmentduration : 6 months Location : Veghel Educationlevel : Bachelor Desiredstudy : Mechatronics & electrical engineering, mechanical engineering & applied physics, software engineering & embedded systems Language : Dutch / English Description of assignment At Vanderlande, we serve customers worldwide by building highly flexible material handling systems out of configurable building blocks. To drive these systems, our Model Based Design (MBD) workflow uses tools like MATLAB/Simulink to develop and test controllers in virtual environments before generating code for various PLC platforms (such as Siemens PLC, Allen-Bradley PLC, and C++). While automated code generation enables versatile deployment, it often makes the generated code unreadable for controls engineers on customer sites, leaving them heavily reliant on basic interface statistics during troubleshooting. In this hands-on project, you will explore new ways to make control software transparent and accessible for site engineers. Focusing on solutions like Simatic Target for Simulink, you will investigate how engineers can deploy generated code while maintaining visual access to the original model. You will analyze current MBD workflows, test new tools on existing OT modules, and evaluate how this way of working improves debugging efficiency and commissioning on site. Department description You will join the Model Based Design (MBD) team within the Technology department, where we develop reusable Operational Technology (OT) modules applied across Vanderlande's global solution portfolio.
